# Psalm 63 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-psalm of-David, when-he-was in-the-wilderness of-Judah.

**2** O-God, You [are] my-God; earnestly I-seek-You. My-soul thirsts for-You; my-flesh faints for-You, in-a-land of-dryness and-weariness, without water.

**3** So in-the-sanctuary I-have-beheld-You, seeing Your-power and-Your-glory.

**4** For better [is] Your-steadfast-love than-life; my-lips praise-You.

**5** So I-bless-You in-my-life; in-Your-name I-lift-up my-hands.

**6** As-with marrow and-fatness my-soul is-satisfied, and-with-lips of-shouts-of-joy my-mouth praises.

**7** When I-remember-You on-my-bed, in-the-watches [of the night] I-meditate on-You.

**8** For You-have-been my-help, and-in-the-shadow of-Your-wings I-sing-for-joy.

**9** My-soul clings to-You; Your-right-hand upholds-me.

**10** But-those-who seek my-soul for-destruction — they-go to-the-depths of-the-earth.

**11** They-are-given-over to-the-power of-the-sword; a-portion of-foxes they-become.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **63:4**: 'Your steadfast love is better than life' — the single most radical value claim in the Psalter. God's love outweighs existence itself.

— EMET
